name: Sticky mobile call, text, and book bar, reshaped into the page on desktop
notes: Original library pattern, not pulled from a client build. Behavior is the mobile call bar used by Benjamin Franklin Plumbing (a fixed Call control on small screens, out of the way on a desktop) extended with Text and Book, which is the set owner-run trades actually use. No animation. Copy the nav and the CSS between the COPY comments, add class has-callbar to body, and put viewport-fit=cover on the viewport meta or the iOS home-indicator inset stays zero. Theme --brand and --accent. The number (555) 010-0137 is fictional — replace the tel: href, the sms: href, and the visible digits together. Point Book at the real scheduler. Breakpoint is 48rem, in one media query. The phone frame in the demo is not part of the copy; it only exists so the pinned bar is visible in the gallery at desktop width. On a real phone the single nav is position: fixed and body padding matches its height, including env(safe-area-inset-bottom).
